svg.aria-label: Five leaf texels in sixteen, and the next mip level down. Each of its texels is the average of four: two leaf and two gap make 0.5, which passes the cutoff, and one leaf and three gaps make 0.25, which does not. The mean alpha stays 0.3125 at both levels, while the share at or above 0.5 falls from 0.3125 to 0.25, and that share is what the cutoff keeps.
